summary: The market has gone flat, with the Nifty barely above Thursday's close and the Sensex slipping into the red as the morning's gains have all but evaporated.

detail.leaders: PSU banks, metals, oil & gas; Bajaj Finance, L&T, Nykaa
detail.laggards: IT, pharma, autos; HCLTech, Asian Paints, HDFC Bank
detail.tone: Softer than the previous note: the Nifty was up just 9.60 points at 22,431.35 at 2:30 pm while the Sensex was marginally lower at 71,891.73.
